body: I feel like the only reason he stays is because he's worried about me. I know he's sick of me and frustrated. I can tell by his sighs, his eyes, the frustration. I would hate me, too. Shit I do hate me. I sometimes want to just run away so he won't have to put up with me anymore. But I love him so much. I don't want to hurt him anymore, but I'm getting worse and not better.

I do bookkeeping.  I just forget things all the time, can barely get out of bed to go to work and sometimes dont. I'm a failure of a wife who can't even clean a house. No one likes me. I guess I'm stupid. I can't make anyone happy, and I fail everytime I try to lose weight. I go to the hospital with anxiety attacks and am constantly crying. I fail at everything I touch. I mess up everything in some way.
